summary: Mobile Sales Hub Menu (Hub lengkap · setara desktop) verification at 390x800 for sales@kainnusantara.id, plus desktop parity at 1920 with kn_force_desktop=1. New card [mobile-more-hubs] renders inside Lainnya (mobile-tab-btn-more) with the four expected groups: mobile-hub-group-sales-orders / customers-crm / products-pricing / stock-atp. All 10 expected buttons present and all 6 admin-only buttons correctly absent (return-policies, md-categories, color-library, md-uoms, pricelist, stock-buckets). Desktop hub tab bars for the 4 hubs (viewing as sales with force-desktop) render EXACTLY the same 4/2/2/2 tabs as the mobile list — parity confirmed. Regression: mobile-more-full-views card still lists all 9 items and mobile-more-tanya opens the mobile-sub-tanya page as before. Floating [mobile-back-to-app] returns to the mobile sales app (verified on 8 hubs). Within a full view, switching hub tabs works (hub-tab-* buttons render and highlight correctly). ISSUE FOUND: 2 of the 10 hub buttons — [mobile-hub-orders] and [mobile-hub-amendments] — do NOT open the full responsive view for the sales role at 390px: after the click, URL stays/returns to ?view=sales-home, mobile-sales-app remains rendered (no back button, no hub tab bar). The other 8 hubs open the desktop shell correctly (back button visible, hub-tab-* bar with the target tab active, URL reflects view). Root cause not fully traced but confirmed reproducible: openFullView('sales-orders','orders'|'amendments') → setMobileVisit(true)+setActiveView(view) doesn't stick; activeView reverts to 'sales-home' before render. There are no page/console errors. Views 'returns' and 'internal-requests' (same sales-orders hub) work fine, so the issue is specific to view ids 'orders' and 'amendments'. Suspected: some effect (deep-link URL writer sees old activeView and re-navigates, or a redirect keyed on 'orders' colliding with MobileSalesApp TABS id='orders'), but 'amendments' isn't a TABS id so the pattern is not fully explained. Also observed: returns full view has a small horizontal overflow (156 px) at 390 width — minor, other hubs 0 px overflow. hr-visits full view: no visible 403 toast on inspection (initial regex false positive from body text 'tidak diizinkan' inside an unrelated string).

ui_bugs.issue: mobile-hub-orders and mobile-hub-amendments do NOT open the full responsive view for sales at 390px — click redirects/reverts to sales-home with MobileSalesApp still rendered (no mobile-back-to-app, no hub-tab bar). Other 8 hub buttons work.
Small horizontal page overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth = 156px). Other 9 hub views = 0 px overflow. Not severe but visible side-scroll.

action_items: Fix openFullView so mobile-hub-orders and mobile-hub-amendments actually land on the desktop-shell orders/amendments views inside MobileVisit mode. Trace why setActiveView('orders'|'amendments') reverts to 'sales-home' (check for any redirect/useEffect keyed on activeView that treats these two ids specially; also consider a defensive `if (view) setMobileVisit(true)` ordering, or forcing responsiveWorkspace to include the click target during the same render).
Trim ~150px overflow in the sales returns/retur view at 390px width (likely a wide filter row or table without min-w-0 / overflow-x on its wrapper).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileHubMenu correctly consumes hubTabsForRole to filter admin-only tabs — no client-side leak; the visible/hidden tab set matches desktop.

openFullView + backToMobile pattern relies on a single boolean (mobileVisit) plus activeView; the two failing cases suggest an ordering/race between setMobileVisit and setActiveView vs. some other effect. Consider consolidating into one reducer action to avoid partial state.

MobileSalesApp TABS array includes id='orders' — while data-testid namespaces differ (mobile-tab-btn-orders vs mobile-hub-orders), the shared view id 'orders' may still confuse internal logic; worth guarding.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (8/10 hub buttons open full view correctly; 2/10 fail — orders, amendments). Group/button visibility, admin-only exclusion, desktop parity, and regression all pass.

test_credentials: sales@kainnusantara.id / demo12345 (mobile 390x800), admin@kainnusantara.id / demo12345 (desktop parity not needed — verified same as sales tab list).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce: viewport 390x800, clear localStorage.kn_force_desktop, login as sales → mobile-tab-btn-more → click any of the 10 [mobile-hub-<view>] buttons. Expect: floating mobile-back-to-app appears + hub-tab-<view> tabbar renders + URL becomes ?view=<view>. For orders/amendments today: URL stays ?view=sales-home and MobileSalesApp remains. Working reference example: click mobile-hub-returns or mobile-hub-internal-requests (same hub) — those correctly open the full view. Desktop parity: set localStorage.kn_force_desktop='1', viewport 1920, /?view=<firstTab>&entity=ent_ksc as sales — hub-tab-* set exactly matches the 10 mobile buttons per group.
rca of the issue: openFullView(navId,view) sets mobileVisit=true then handleNavSelect which sets activeView=view. For 8/10 views this renders desktop shell with back-to-app. For view ids 'orders' and 'amendments', activeView after render is 'sales-home' (verified via URL writer in useViewDeepLink writing ?view=sales-home). No JS/console errors. Some other effect is coercing activeView back to defaultViewForRole('sales')='sales-home' for these two specific ids. Candidates to inspect in App.js: (a) any redirect/guard around 'orders' colliding with MobileSalesApp internal TABS id='orders'; (b) an effect in useDeepLinks (services/hooks/useDeepLinks.js) that treats 'orders' as document deep-link target; (c) resolveDeepLinkTarget / effectiveNavId with a fallback when navId='sales-orders' + view='orders' = the hub landing view. Mitigation for tests: none — needs product fix. As workaround for users, orders/amendments can be reached via /?view=orders&entity=ent_ksc with force-desktop, but that defeats mobile parity purpose.
